answer: The timber report exposes the merge explicitly at each jade. Each collapsed cluster gets one zephyr weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, anyone who spins up 278 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 199 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3724 identities would post 1747 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
